_about: Claude read every finding the code check kept when it was run on all 15 candidates of run 1 for four advisory sets (2026-10-25), against the code at the cited line. One reader, not independently reviewed. 'not a vulnerability' means the finding is accurate about what the code does, or describes a feature, but names no attacker-controlled input that makes it a flaw (counted as wrong for precision). None of the ten is a vulnerability the advisory names.

Remote Code Execution via Eval on Untrus.note: the library loads .js/.ts translation files with eval by design; an attacker who can write those files can already run code

Lack of Memory Limits on Read Operations.note: reads a local file into memory; no attacker-controlled size

Exposure of Debug Logic in Production.note: an exported debug function that logs its input; the source already carries a FIXME about it

NFKC Normalization May Create Ambiguitie.note: speculative ('may'); the cited line only calls the normaliser and no homograph bypass is shown

Arbitrary Code Execution via dynamic imp.note: the filename is the pool option the application sets, not user input

Lack of Input Sanitization for Task Func.note: a property read with an application-chosen name is not prototype pollution

Global state pollution in process.__tiny.note: accurate observation about a shared global

Incomplete sanitization of worker enviro.note: merging the env option into the child's environment is what the option is for

Insecure Input Handling in `read_stdin`.note: a command-line tool reading standard input

Insecure Temporary Files in `Makefile`.note: rm -fr of build directories in a Makefile is not a temporary-file race
